instruction: Find the lowest sales value in the June column and add a comment or note to that cell containing the text "Lowest".

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding min value in June column (column G). Verified with Python: min=175 at row 10 (Kandice Hussey), cell G10. Evaluator checks if G10 has a comment containing the text 'Lowest'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks if cell G10 has a comment containing 'Lowest', but does NOT verify that G10 actually contains the lowest value in the June column
Instruction requires TWO steps: (1) Find the lowest sales value in June column, (2) Add comment to that cell. Evaluator only verifies step 2
If user adds comment to wrong cell (e.g., G5 instead of G10), evaluator would incorrectly fail even if the comment logic is correct
Hard-coded cell address (G10) assumes the minimum value location, but doesn't verify this assumption
Getter and metric logic for comment checking is correct (case-insensitive text matching, proper comment extraction)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file to persist the comment before verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a second evaluator check that verifies G10 contains the minimum value in column G (e.g., compare G10's value against all other values in column G)
Alternatively, modify the getter to dynamically find the cell with minimum value in column G, then verify that cell has the comment (instead of hard-coding G10)
Consider using a multi-step evaluator with partial credit: 50% for correct minimum value identification, 50% for comment on correct cell
